name: Revenium Hook Observer
description: Spike 009 (SPIKE-02) - registers exactly the six D-08 hooks (before_prompt_build, after_tool_call, before_agent_finalize, subagent_spawned, subagent_ended, session_end) and appends one record per fire to an append-only file this project owns. Records structural/metadata fields only, never raw prompt/tool/message content.
